notes:
v4.6.13 — Universe-bot ASSIGNMENT per trading bot

✨ NEW
• Each trading bot tab now has a 'Universe bot' dropdown that picks WHICH universe bot's output it consumes. Separates two distinct decisions:
  1) Universe TAB dropdown picks which universe script you RUN (= which scanner refreshes a *_universe.txt file)
  2) Bot TAB dropdown picks which universe BOT (= whose .txt output) this trading bot reads from
  Picking the crypto universe bot on your DAY trading bot means: DAY bot now trades whatever the crypto universe writes (until you change it).
• Setting key changed from 'bot_universe_<SIDE>' (file path) to 'bot_universe_script_<SIDE>' (script id). The widget resolves the id to the target file at bot launch using each script's META.universe, so updates to the universe bot's target are picked up automatically. Legacy file-path setting still honored for back-compat.
• Built-in entry 'Built-in universe_manager → <your default>.txt' restores the pre-v4.6.13 default behaviour with one click.
